name: Ruby
source:
Ordinarily, he does not show himself in front of others. [spoiler]
Since his birth, Ruby has lived his life fulfilling his task of culling bee larvae by cannibalising them. Unlike ordinary bees, Ruby does not chiefly feed on humans. Due to him being a cannibal, he is loathed by the other bees. Embracing Menou's lack of knowledge of this aspect of him, Ruby wishes to become her husband...[/spoiler]

[Based on the tanslation of the official website profile.]
